title: A variable-length record
hints: The block holds the struct plus the values: `sizeof(struct scores) + count * sizeof(int)`. `sizeof` of a struct with a flexible array member does not include the array.

`strncpy` does not add a terminating zero when the name fills the buffer: set the last byte to `'\0'` yourself. `realloc` may move the block, so `scores_add` returns the pointer the caller must use from then on.
lessonTitle: Struct Layout, Alignment and Bit Fields
